implements_from_adr004.section_2_3: A write-once, server-derived implicit TaskSpec for each Session.
implements_from_adr004.section_2_5: Append-only accepted/rejected TaskExecutionResolution records; accepted Resolution and TaskAttempt rows are committed in one database transaction.
implements_from_adr004.section_2_10: A true TaskAttempt with immutable execution_zone_id and PID history distinct from RuntimeRun/PID state.

p1b_amendments.detail: For the P1b implicit path only, the Nexus Session Runtime Service is the authorized writer of TaskSpec, TaskExecutionResolution and TaskAttempt. Explicit Task ingress remains reserved for later Moss/Local productization.
Nexus owns task.sudo.dev/v1 locally. With no external consumer in P1b, it is not added to the sudostack derived schema set.

An Attempt is created queued, becomes running after PID attachment, becomes failed when an accepted start fails, and becomes cancelled through revoke linkage. PID cancellation does not mutate Attempt state.
task_specs UNIQUE(session_id) enforces exactly one implicit Task per Session. Explicit multi-Task support requires a later schema migration.

TaskSpec is the first-start write-once request snapshot; Resolution is the final decision record. Database rows are authoritative. VFS JSON is an immutable creation snapshot and may lag after a process crash.

recorded_gaps: No public Task write ingress or Moss Task API is introduced; interactive, Cron, IM, Team and explicit retry product paths remain future work.

The resolver covers requester/session authorization, declared resource/Zone grants, execution-zone decision and zone liveness. Agent resolution/approval, required runtime capabilities, classification/egress, local-only handling, organization requested-mode policy, deadline, budget and approval remain future work.
The start request omits ADR-001 task_id and attempt_id because the implicit service generates them.
workspace_refs is omitted and input.resource_refs is represented by the optional start-body resource_refs field; an omitted field does not trigger resource validation.
TaskSpec omits request_source, agent, data_classification, required_capabilities, workspace_refs, input.parameters, constraints, output_contract, parent_task_id and supersedes_task_id.
Accepted Resolution omits resolved_runtime, resolution_mode and agent.
TaskAttempt omits agent, output_refs, evidence_refs and verify_result_ref. starting, awaiting_input, output_ready, verifying and completed are schema-valid but unreachable in P1b.
Resource refs supplied on later non-resume starts are validated but are not written back into the write-once TaskSpec or Resolution.
